# MW-1307: Consolidate ARSY backlog index and dependency governance

## Purpose
Canonical index for the ARSY native-intelligence workstream. This Issue coordinates the existing 35 implementation/research tasks; it does not duplicate their acceptance criteria or authorize implementation by itself.

## Backlog map

### A. Architecture and persistence foundation
- [MW-1272 — Ratify ARSY research baseline](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/194)
- [MW-1273 — Audit native agent runtime/provider boundaries](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/195)
- [MW-1274 — Audit QlOrm transactions/concurrency/SQLite](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/196)
- [MW-1275 — Decide canonical domain ownership](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/197)

### B. Runtime contracts, inference, context, tools, policy
- [MW-1276 — Typed cognitive-runtime contracts](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/198)
- [MW-1277 — Provider capabilities/timeouts/errors](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/199)
- [MW-1278 — Deterministic context assembly/token budgets](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/200)
- [MW-1279 — Typed tool registry contract](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/201)
- [MW-1280 — Deny-by-default tool policy](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/202)
- [MW-1281 — Human approval/risk policy](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/203)

### C. Durable execution and native agent loop
- [MW-1282 — QlOrm transaction support](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/204)
- [MW-1283 — Durable run/step persistence](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/205)
- [MW-1284 — Append-only events/evidence](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/206)
- [MW-1285 — Atomic claims/leases/idempotency](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/207)
- [MW-1286 — Native bounded execution loop](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/208)
- [MW-1287 — Timeout/retry/cancel/recovery](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/209)

### D. Memory, planning, world model, learning
- [MW-1288 — Memory ownership/privacy/retention](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/210)
- [MW-1289 — Episodic memory persistence](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/211)
- [MW-1290 — Provenance-aware memory retrieval](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/212)
- [MW-1291 — Semantic memory consolidation](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/213)
- [MW-1292 — Bounded goal decomposition/replanning](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/214)
- [MW-1293 — Outcome verification/reflection](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/215)
- [MW-1294 — Versioned procedural skills](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/216)
- [MW-1295 — Evidence-backed world/task state](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/217)
- [MW-1304 — Evaluated learning/promotion/rollback](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/226)
- [MW-1305 — Long-running multi-session continuity](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/227)

### E. Evaluation, security, external reality interfaces
- [MW-1296 — Evaluation harness/scorecard](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/218)
- [MW-1297 — Rights-reviewed benchmark portfolio](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/219)
- [MW-1298 — Threat model/red-team tests](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/220)
- [MW-1299 — Isolated Playwright executor](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/221)
- [MW-1300 — Authorized YouTube adapter](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/222)
- [MW-1301 — Official WhatsApp Business API adapter](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/223)
- [MW-1303 — Evidence-based model routing](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/225)
- [MW-1306 — Capability report/AGI-claim policy](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/228)

### F. System Observatory operator experience
- [MW-1302 — Execution/trace/evidence views](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/224)

## Dependency and status policy
1. Each child Issue remains the source of truth for its scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and evidence.
2. Keep a child Issue `status:proposed` while any declared dependency is open.
3. Promote to `status:pending` only when every dependency is closed and the work is ready to start; use `status:in-progress` only when work actually begins.
4. Close only with implementation/research evidence and exact-SHA required checks. Never infer completion from code presence or a model response.
5. Do not remove a genuine blocker label merely to make the board look unblocked. Resolve the missing prerequisite or environment first, then update the status.
6. No OpenClaw or third-party agent framework as core runtime; no duplicate database, ORM, identity, provider, connector, or conversation store.
7. No Wiki work is included, per owner direction.

## Current consolidation evidence
- Research/architecture baseline is documented in PR #193; it is still open and not merged.
- Child issues #194–#228 were audited. All are open; #194 is `status:in-progress`; the remaining 34 are `status:proposed`.
- Broken dependency hyperlinks in child issue bodies were corrected where the target MW task ID mapped to a known issue number.
- The QlOrm transaction/concurrency audit (#196) remains a hard prerequisite before durable atomic claims or scheduler behavior.
- This index is coordination only; it does not mark any child task complete or authorize bypassing dependency gates.


## Adjacent legacy blockers reviewed (not ARSY child tasks)
These records were checked because they touch agent-runtime or operational verification. They remain separate workstreams and are not silently merged into this backlog:

- [MW-1243 — Rights-grounded Qur'an chat parent](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/164) remains open with `status:blocked`; its child flow is not fully accepted.
- [MW-1249 — Render chat citations/evidence states](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/170) remains open with `status:blocked`; implementation and exact-SHA Actions are recorded as passing, but required browser click-through has not been observed.
- [MW-1250 — Evaluate grounded chat/pilot readiness](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/171) remains open with `status:blocked`; it depends on MW-1248/MW-1249 and still lacks browser evidence, current rights-cleared pilot evidence, and a qualified reviewer.
- [MW-0558 — CAB manual browser click-through](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/23) remains open with `status:blocked`; isolated local workflow environment and non-production accounts are unavailable. This is not an ARSY dependency.
- Legacy agent tasks [MW-1217](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/105) and [MW-1218](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/106) are already closed and have no current `status:blocked` label. Their imported historical snapshots say blocked, but that is not a reason to reopen them or duplicate their scope.

**Unblocking rule:** these are already GitHub-open where noted; the blocker is the status label and unmet acceptance evidence, not a closed issue state. Do not remove `status:blocked` until the concrete missing environment/evidence/child acceptance is supplied. This avoids falsely presenting a task as ready.


### Repository-wide historical status scan
A repository-wide search also found 30 closed Issues that still carry the `status:blocked` label. They are outside the ARSY child range and are already closed in GitHub. They were not reopened or relabeled in this pass: a stale/historical status label alone is insufficient evidence to reverse a closed decision. Handle them in a separate tracker-hygiene review with each close reason and acceptance record checked first.


## Read-only source audit updates (2026-11-02)
Preliminary source-backed findings were recorded directly in the child Issues:
- [MW-1273 / #195 — agent-runtime/provider reuse and gap matrix](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/195#issuecomment-6578563068)
- [MW-1274 / #196 — QlOrm/libSQL/PostgreSQL transaction and concurrency audit](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/196#issuecomment-6578564837)
- [MW-1275 / #197 — provisional addon/domain ownership map](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/197#issuecomment-6578566646)

These are explicitly preliminary comments, not completion or validation evidence. #194 remains open/in-progress, so #195 and #196 remain proposed; #197 remains proposed until both audits close. No code was changed and no local quality gate was run. The most concrete architectural blocker is the absence of a transaction-scoped QlOrm API; PostgreSQL currently uses pool-level query calls without a pinned client, and the libSQL wrapper does not expose the driver's transaction object.

## Task contract

<!-- mw-task-record-end -->

## Context

Qorpus already has the data model and reader boundaries needed for a curated Qur'an corpus. This task fills the content gap: one complete, precisely identified Arabic edition should be available as the default Qur'an work. The default must be a real, reviewable edition with source provenance—not a hard-coded text array or a silently fetched third-party API.

## Implementation outline

1. Inspect the current importer/data-seed conventions and confirm the exact ql_source / ql_corpus service APIs.
2. Evaluate candidate digital source editions and document the selected source, version, orthography, reading tradition metadata, numbering convention, attribution, and reuse/display terms.
3. Create the frozen source artifact/version and rights record. If rights cannot be cleared, stop before publication.
4. Build an offline importer that writes stable source and corpus records, stages the edition, and reports completeness/checksum differences.
5. Review the imported edition against the source manifest and the corpus's surah/ayah metadata. Resolve the existing numbering-convention comment before calling the data complete.
6. Publish only after explicit rights and editorial review; then expose it as the default Qur'an entry in Qorpus.
7. Add the separate translation edition only when its own exact source, translator, attribution, and display rights are approved.

## Explicit product decisions

- The Arabic Qur'an is the canonical default dataset; Arabic revelation text is never represented as a translation.
- The selected digital text edition and its orthographic/numbering conventions must be named.
- Indonesian translation is a separate follow-on edition, not an invisible layer merged into the Arabic text.
- Tafsir, transliteration, audio, word-by-word grammar, and other commentary are separate future scope.
- Issue #164 remains the distinct chat MVP and is not duplicated here.

## Child work items

- #166 (MW-1245): Grounded response contract and agent output validation.
- #167 (MW-1246): Rights-aware Qur'an passage indexing and retrieval, blocked by #166.
- #168 (MW-1247): Citation persistence and ownership, blocked by #166.
- #169 (MW-1248): Chat API integration, blocked by #166, #167, and #168.
- #170 (MW-1249): Assistant citation UI, blocked by #169.
- #171 (MW-1250): Evaluation and pilot readiness, blocked by #169 and #170.

MW-1244 (#165), the separate canonical-dataset and rights-evidence task, is proposed and is not required for coding against existing eligible records. Its rights and source stop conditions remain in force.

## Implementation outline

1. Add rights-aware, bounded retrieval and an idempotent index lifecycle for eligible passages. Index snippets must not become a way to disclose corpus text through generic search.
2. Add a typed grounded-agent result and validate citations against the retrieved evidence set.
3. Persist grounding status and citation references through ql_chat and the owner-scoped conversation store; revalidate on history reads.
4. Extend the shared chat contract and wire retrieval, abstention, persistence, and explicit error behavior through the existing API route.
5. Render citation metadata and grounding states in the assistant UI with localized id/en copy.
6. Add boundary tests and complete the recorded browser and exact-SHA GitHub Actions verification.

## Product decisions

- Scope is limited to existing Qur'an corpus editions that are published and currently cleared for display.
- Arabic-script questions select locale `ar`. Other questions select the authenticated user's UI locale (`id` or `en`). No source-language fallback is allowed.
- Edition selection is automatic; no selector is part of the pilot. Absence of eligible evidence results in abstention, not an ungrounded model answer.
- The MVP does not establish universal language, tradition, or community coverage.

# MW-0584: Raise mobile tap targets in `@moonwitness/ui` composites to 44px and make the closed sidebar drawer inert

> Current workflow status is this Issue state plus its status label. The imported task row below is immutable migration provenance.

## Task contract
- **Owner:** Owner
- **Section:** Workstream MW-0570 — Centralise UI into `@moonwitness/ui`
- **Source status:** `proposed`; current status is the `status:proposed` label.

### Acceptance criteria
Every element rendered by `@moonwitness/ui` meets a >=44x44 CSS px hit area at 375x780: `.ql-nav-link` gets a `min-h-11` (or equivalent) so a screen does not have to override it, `Button` size variants `sm` and `icon` grow to 44px on touch media query, and `SidebarBrand` reaches 44px. The workspace sidebar drawer applies `visibility: hidden` (or sets `inert`) when closed and only becomes focusable once opened, and its open/close state is announced via `aria-expanded` on the trigger. # MW-0583: Remove design-system CSS that reached into `apps/web` markup

> Current workflow status is this Issue state plus its status label. The imported tracker row below is immutable cutover provenance, not current status.

## Task contract
- **Owner:** Owner
- **Imported status:** `done` (historical snapshot)

### Acceptance criteria
`packages/ui/styles/components.css` contains no rule that selects a Tailwind default-palette class (`text-stone-*`, `border-stone-200`, `bg-white`, `bg-emerald-500`) or an `aria-label` string owned by a screen, and keeps no `!important` whose only purpose was to beat app-side utilities; every deleted selector is proven dead by a source scan of `apps/web/src/**/*.tsx`; `.ql-hud-brand` reads a token instead of a hardcoded hex; `pnpm exec turbo run build` stays green

### Dependencies
- [**MW-0576**](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/29)

No evidence field was recorded in the source row.

No execution packet was present in the source row.

# MW-0580: Ship SidebarNav, IconTile, MetricRow, ListOption, SidePanel and WorkspaceSidebar composites

> Current workflow status is this Issue state plus its status label. The imported tracker row below is immutable cutover provenance, not current status.

## Task contract
- **Owner:** Owner
- **Imported status:** `done` (historical snapshot)
- **Status note at migration:** Implemented; exported from `@moonwitness/ui` and consumed by apps/web screens, plus `OptionNav` for the sidebar lists whose rows are selectable options (model picker, DNS zones, chat history) so no screen writes `className="ql-sidebar-nav"` any more; `PageHeader`'s eyebrow now renders the shared `.ql-eyebrow` rule instead of a utility copy (measured in the browser: 0.65rem/650/uppercase, the same rule `SidePanel` uses)

- [**MW-0579**](https://github.com/bjo163/moonwitness-reborn/issues/32)
